title: The Blue Hour of the coast road
author: Kestrel Winterbourne
blurb: Bram Joubert, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
